messages:
michael: hey team :wave: just unboxed my company MBP (M2, 16GB). during setup kandji fails at enrollment with 'Enrollment conflict: UUID mismatch' and it jumped into the user setup flow asking to use my personal iCloud for FileVault recovery. not sure what to do — need temp admin to install docker/rosetta and don't want my personal iCloud involved. who can help?

it-bot: Automated check: device claim mismatch detected. Please ping #new-hires or @devin (IT) with the device serial. See https://redwood.internal/it-forms/device-reclaim for context.

devin (IT): @michael can take this. that UUID/claim error usually means the device record was reused or reimaged without clearing the claim. do NOT complete the iCloud FileVault flow if you can avoid it. can you paste the serial from `system_profiler` output? also tell us if you started any OS update (sonoma/etc).

michael: pasted output below:
```
$ system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep 'Serial'
Serial Number (system): C02W1234G8H9
```
I did click through an OS update prompt earlier but it didn't finish.

kyle (IT Ops): @michael ok. i can grant a 24h temp admin ACL so you can install brew/docker. i'll need a quick thumbs-up from you to apply. once we have the serial i'll reassign the device in Kandji and push a reprovision.

sophia (Security): quick security note: our MDM escrows FileVault recovery keys to Redwood-managed KMS (HSM-wrapped). we DO NOT store personal iCloud recovery keys in company escrow. if you already used iCloud during setup, DM me — we can rotate the recovery and rekey under the company escrow.

devin (IT): steps i'll perform after serial confirm: 1) unclaim/rescind old device entry in Kandji, 2) re-enroll the hardware ID to you, 3) push FileVault policy (company escrow via KMS), 4) run optional post-install scripts. michael, once you confirm temp admin, i'll open ticket and do the reassign.

michael: yes please grant temp admin for 24h, i only need to install brew + docker desktop + small tooling.

kyle (IT Ops): granted — ticket IT-4829 created and role `temp-admin-24h` applied. you should see `sudo` access now. run `whoami` and `sudo -v` to confirm.

michael: `whoami` shows my user, `sudo -v` prompted for password and worked. installing docker now. if i hit permissions errors i'll paste logs.

devin (IT): for the FileVault bit: after i reprovision Kandji we'll push the FV profile which triggers escrow to KMS automatically. if you triggered an iCloud FV step earlier, please stop and reboot into recovery if possible. we can also avoid a destructive rekey thanks to MDM-managed rekey flow.

sophia (Security): tagging process notes for audit: if a personal iCloud key was used we mark it as user-provided and rotate on reprovision. no user PII leaves the device; escrow keys are KMS-wrapped with our org key.

michael: re-provision completed on my end — Kandji shows device assigned to me, FileVault flow ran and i got a company recovery message on the MDM console. docker installed fine after a quick `softwareupdate` for the system extensions. everything looks good. thanks @devin @kyle @sophia :thumbsup:

devin (IT): great — closing IT-4829. if anything else pops up ping us here or DM. marking thread resolved.

michael: thanks everyone! first-week win :)
